Who We Are

BUILT FOR AFRICA'S FUTURE

Foxtrot Systems is a leading telecommunications and electrocommunication company headquartered in Zimbabwe, dedicated to bridging the digital divide across the African continent. We deploy robust, scalable infrastructure solutions that empower communities, businesses, and governments with reliable connectivity.

Our team of certified engineers and ICT specialists brings decades of combined experience in designing, deploying and maintaining mission-critical communication networks in challenging environments.

🎯
Our Mission
To connect every African community with world-class communication infrastructure.
🔭
Our Vision
An Africa where reliable connectivity is a fundamental right, not a privilege.
⚡
Innovation
Adopting the latest technologies to deliver future-ready infrastructure today.
🤝
Community
Empowering communities by making digital access affordable and sustainable.

What We Do

OUR SERVICES

End-to-end telecommunication solutions engineered for Africa's unique landscape and challenges.

01
📡
Telecommunications Infrastructure

Design, supply and installation of telecommunications towers, masts, and antenna systems. We handle everything from site surveys and structural assessments to civil works and commissioning.

Tower Erection Site Survey Civil Works
02
🔗
Network Connectivity Solutions

Fibre optic cabling, microwave link deployment, and last-mile connectivity solutions that keep businesses and communities online with maximum reliability and minimum latency.

Fibre Optic Microwave Last Mile
03
☀️
Solar Power Systems

Off-grid and hybrid solar power installations for telecom sites and community facilities. We ensure your network stays operational even in areas without stable grid power.

Off-Grid Hybrid Solar Battery Storage
04
🔌
Electrical & Cabling Works

Comprehensive electrical installation and structured cabling services for commercial, industrial, and residential projects. Certified electricians delivering safe, code-compliant solutions.

LV/MV Systems Structured Cabling Compliance
05
🛰️
Satellite Communication

VSAT installation and maintenance for remote sites, rural communities, and mining operations where terrestrial networks are unavailable or unreliable.

VSAT Remote Sites Rural Connectivity
06
🛠️
Operations & Maintenance

Preventive and corrective maintenance programs for telecom infrastructure. 24/7 NOC monitoring, rapid response field teams, and SLA-backed support agreements.

24/7 NOC Preventive Maintenance SLA Support
